description: CRIT-002 states 'link session validated early (before advisory lock)' for the cancel flow. In cancel.ts:32-43, findLinkSession + expiry/used checks happen before acquireAdvisoryLock at line 46. This is correctly implemented. However, CRIT-002 also states 'consumed after acceptance boundary' but the PROP-BILL-063 test does not explicitly assert that consumeLinkSession occurs AFTER the acceptance boundary check — it only asserts findMember < consumeSession < setInflight. The acceptance boundary check (calculateCancelAcceptanceStart + isCancelAcceptable) is a pure-core function call at cancel.ts:80-85 that is not instrumented in the callOrder recording. The step ordering test would pass even if consumption happened before the boundary check, because the pure function calls are not tracked.

evidence.snippet: PROP-BILL-063 call order: findLinkSession → acquireAdvisoryLock → findMemberByDiscordUserId → consumeLinkSession → setInflightOperation → cancelSubscription → updateMemberAfterCancel. Missing: calculateCancelAcceptanceStart/isCancelAcceptable are not tracked because they are pure function calls without mock recording.
